import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema.validators import validator_for
observations = []
for path in sorted(Path("references/schemas").glob("*.schema.json")):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    schema = json.loads(raw)
    validator_for(schema).check_schema(schema)
    observations.append({"path": path.as_posix(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "json_parse": "PASS", "schema_definition": "PASS"})
if len(observations) != 11:
    raise SystemExit("Expected the reviewed eleven-schema inventory")
print(json.dumps(observations))
